resources.string: This app opens the Scratch Cookie Cottage admin portal. Enter the website address — no /admin at the end.
At home on Wi‑Fi, use your computer’s address, for example http://192.168.1.249:5000\n\nAfter the site is hosted, use https://www.scratchcookiecottage.com
Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://
Could not reach the site. Check the address and that the computer is running the server on the same Wi‑Fi.
